scope: test-only runtime memory accounting; ordinary provider/Core/codec ownership unchanged; excludes allocator internals/RSS/VM memory

units.bytes: all fields except Format and scope-event counts20..23; peak is simultaneous per-domain accounting maximum
units.object_layout: 24..26 actual compiler sizeof, not allocator usable-size or measured physical stack frames

semantics: CoreRetained includes actual reserved canonical UTF-8 permits, never a failed pre-admission request.
PublicationStaging includes only adopted nonnull provider allocations before commit; commit transfers role, abort decrements after paired destruction.

ProviderObject and ProviderText split actual object allocation requests and external text capacity/storage; inline string bytes are already within object sizeof. ProviderStoragePeak is their simultaneous sum, not sum of independent peaks.
C flexible bytes use source.size; C++ uses observed external capacity+1 and excludes SSO; Rust uses actual successful String.capacity plus exact Model Layout, including temporary String before Box.
Utf8Backing is actual external Input.text capacity+1 under the pinned C++17 library; InputObject/Utf16Array are declared active-scope object storage.
Provider and conversion acquired/released totals follow actual success and after-destruction events. Test bookkeeping and Context/Core/VM/allocator storage are excluded.
Runtime cumulative across sequential Engine generations, not reset per connect; bounded history retains final counters.
One locked counter-copy is internally consistent; it is not a transaction with the separate178 frame or the VM heap. Stable held gate/final lifetime is required for cross-frame assertions.

ModelObjectSize is set at the actual provider bind; without that bind testMemory returns NotReady. InputObjectSize/Utf16ArraySize remain zero until their respective actual conversion scope first executes; zero means that layout has not yet been observed, not a measured zero-sized object.
